note: Reference numbers of the workbook: the lattice of Jürgensen, Mukherjee, Jörg, Rechtsman, Nature Physics 19, 420 (2023), five waveguides per unit cell, conventions as in app/js/workbook/aah.js (+J; band b = b-th eigenvalue; gamma = -arg of the closed product of overlaps; plaquette walked (k, phase) -> (k, phase + d) -> (k + d, phase + d) -> (k + d, phase)). Computed with numpy, independently of the page, in two ways that agree (grid of eigenvectors with Runge-Kutta propagation; band projectors, a Wannier state from the projected position operator and propagation with exact exponentials). Units: positions in micrometres, couplings and eigenvalues in 1/mm, phases in units of pi, positions of the light in unit cells. chern_cosine_model_N40: the couplings J_n = 1 + 0.5 cos(phase + 4 pi n/5) instead of the exponential law of the experiment give other Chern numbers.
